description: List the event's most recent email sends (up to 100), optionally for one contactId. Use it to check whether someone was emailed or why a message did not arrive. Returns activity[] with id, contactId, to, subject, sentAt, and the queued, delivery, failure, bounce, complaint, or suppression status, plus truncated.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: get_email_activity

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
